name: clean-buy
description: Orderly breakout: a quiet opening range (79.74-80.16), a news spike just after it that sets the 82.10 session high and fades, a quiet base under the opening-range high, then a rising-volume push through it. Last close 80.42 is above or_high 80.16 and about 1.4 ATR above VWAP 80.27 (not extended). A level plan at VWAP risks 0.17 (about 1.5 ATR, a tight structural stop); at or_high it risks 0.28 (about 2.5 ATR). Both 2R targets (80.76, 80.98) sit well below the 82.10 session high. News is positive (analyst upgrade, supply contract, raised guidance), a material-agreement 8-K, no red flags.

expected.why: Clean breakout, tight stop, room for 2R before the session high, positive catalysts, no red flags.
